mathematics.assertion_tested: On-shell decay into two lower Bogoliubov modes using full cubic vertex; vacuum normalization and derivative cross-checks.

mathematics.conventions: Natural units; m=delta=n=1 in dimensionless mode calculation, M=2m in kinetic dispersion; zero temperature, infinite uniform condensate.
non_claims: Not a full finite-temperature spectral function or finite-cloud calculation.

No new Lean certification of the decay amplitude.
